FA Vase

Which non-league clubs will take part in the FA Vase first round proper?

The FA Vase first round proper draw is in, with 103 ties set for the next round.

  • by

    Harry Whitfield
  • 14 September 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:47
Instaread

The FA Vase first round proper draw has been made, with 103 ties set to take place on Saturday, October 10th as clubs continue their journey towards Wembley.

The 180 winners from the second qualifying round are joined by 26 clubs entering at this stage after reaching last season’s third round proper.

Whitley Bay’s FA Vase pedigree counted for nothing at the weekend as Darlington Town produced one of the round’s biggest shocks, winning 2-1 at Hillheads Park thanks to Nathan Stephenson’s late free-kick.

Newport Pagnell Town also impressed, seeing off Virginia Water 2-0 with first-half goals from Fin Jaggard and Corvell Pickering, while Westfields progressed after Tyrese Sibanda’s second-half double secured a 2-1 victory over Stone Old Alleynians.

There were also several emphatic wins, with FC St Helens thrashing Frickley Athletic 9-0 and East Grinstead Town beating Lydd Town by the same scoreline. Holker Old Boys also put seven past Seaton Carew.

Attention now turns to the ties that will determine who reaches the second round proper, with 25 clubs already assured of a place after reaching last season’s fourth round proper.

The full draw was made on Monday and is available below. And here’s everything you need to know ahead of the next round.

For exclusive stories and all the detailed Non-League news you need, subscribe to The Non-League Paper website, digital edition, or newspaper from as little as 14p a day.

When will the first round proper take place?

The default date for all 82 ties is Saturday 10 October 2026, with kick-offs scheduled for 3pm – however, ties could be moved in advance.

What is the FA Vase prize money?

There is £825 on offer to every winning club in the first round proper, while losing sides receive £250.

The prize fund increases as clubs progress:

When are the next rounds?

The second round proper is scheduled for Saturday 31 October, when the competition moves into its next stage.

The final will take place at Wembley on Sunday 16 May 2027.

The full schedule is:

  • Second Round Proper: Saturday 31 October 2026
  • Third Round Proper: Saturday 28 November 2026
  • Fourth Round Proper: Saturday 9 January 2027
  • Fifth Round Proper: Saturday 6 February 2027
  • Sixth Round Proper: Saturday 6 March 2027
  • Semi-final, first leg: Saturday 3 April 2027
  • Semi-final, second leg: Saturday 10 April 2027
  • Final: Sunday 16 May 2027
